fullPassage: Self-regulation has been suggested as an alternative way to hold the tech industry to account. (A) But without consequences for violating them, these charters are just toothless statements of aspiration. The tech industry is basically saying: trust us. But blind trust is not how we govern doctors, lawyers, bankers, pilots or anyone else in unelected positions of social responsibility. Tech is the exception, and it’s not clear why. (B) But when tech lobbyists speak of self-regulation, they are not describing it as it is understood by professionals like doctors. Unlike in medicine, there are no mandatory ethical qualifications for working as a software engineer or technology executive. There is no enforceable industry code of conduct. There is no obligatory certification. There is no duty to put the public ahead of profit. (C) There are few consequences for serious moral failings; no real fear of being suspended or struck off. Recent years have seen an explosion of AI ethics charters and the like, filled with well-meaning generalities about the responsible use of powerful computers.

questions.passage: Self-regulation has been suggested as an alternative way to hold the tech industry to account. But without consequences for violating them, these charters are just toothless statements of aspiration. The tech industry is basically saying: trust us. But blind trust is not how we govern doctors, lawyers, bankers, pilots or anyone else in unelected positions of social responsibility. Tech is the exception, and it’s not clear why. But when tech lobbyists speak of self-regulation, they are not describing it as it is understood by professionals like doctors. Unlike in medicine, there are no mandatory ethical qualifications for working as a software engineer or technology executive. There is no enforceable industry code of conduct. There is no obligatory certification. There is no duty to put the public ahead of profit. There are few consequences for serious moral failings; no real fear of being suspended or struck off. Recent years have seen an explosion of AI ethics charters and the like, filled with well-meaning generalities about the responsible use of powerful computers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술산업의 자율규제는 형식(헌장, 일반론)만 있고 실질적 규제(의무, 처벌)가 없다
det.analysis:
✅ ② 약속은 많고 실천은 없다 — 헌장은 있지만 구속력/처벌이 없다는 본문의 핵심 비판을 반영 ←정답
❌ ① 새로운 이정표 — 본문은 헌장을 긍정적으로 평가하지 않음
❌ ③ 같은 윤리 기준 — 본문은 의사와 기술산업의 윤리 기준이 다르다고 비판
❌ ④ 성공적 자율규제 — 본문은 자율규제가 실패했다고 비판
det.tip: 자율규제 = 형식(charters, generalities)만 있고 실질(enforcement, consequences)은 없다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 toothless statements of aspiration이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: toothless(이빨 없는=실효성 없는) + statements of aspiration(열망의 진술) = 구속력 없는 무력한 선언

✅ ② 구속력 없이 선한 의도만 담긴 무력한 선언 — toothless(무력한) + aspiration(열망/선의)의 조합으로 구속력 없는 선언을 의미 ←정답
❌ ③ 윤리적 자격 요건 — 진술(statements)이지 자격 요건이 아님
❌ ④ 전문적 규율 체계 — toothless는 규율 체계의 부재를 비유
det.tip: toothless = 이빨 없는 → 실효성/구속력 없는. statements of aspiration = 열망만 담긴 진술
